Task: ajc-optimize
Title: Make the project clean and optimized
Project(s) — work across all of them:
- Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge at MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge
References: roadmap=AJC.jacobian,AJC.maintenance; inbox=I-0312,I-0314,I-0315,I-0316,I-0319

This project is already well advanced. Another project chooses another route, Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild, you can read some parts and get inspiration from it. However I want you to continue Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge, whose route is more ambitious and mathematically more useful. I first want the blueprints to be cleaner, the roadmap to be refactored to be cleaner (using subitems etc) showing clearly what's been done and what's still to be done. Moreover the code quality should be enhanced, for instance the build time (mostly for Cech) is very high, the code might not use good mathlib convention, and might not be optimized, there are heartbeat everywhere. This task is to optimize and improve the work that was already done, and organize it better.
In the current roadmap all the already done items (like sheafs, schemes, etc, etc) should all be represented with done label, so that it is easier to follow up the real progress. Moreover I'd like an estimation of the build time, in my old attempts it was 6h, I'd like it to be under 1 hour for a build from scratch if possible. Once everything is clean, we may set the task as done and consider continuing the project.

This is a headless, one-shot session: work the task's REAL objective as far
as you genuinely can, committing progress as you go, then finish with the
brief final report the skill specifies.
